posts.content_md:
I am not working with film but we had a few of these refridgerator magnetic photo mounts laying around. They are very inexpensive and a matt frame around the hologram could be made out of paper. Might be a nice quick way of framing film holograms. The ones we have are basically a piece of acrylic folded over. You slide the photo or hologram in the open end. Just a thought.

[http://www.amazon.com/exec/obidos/tg/de ... 2?v=glance](http://www.amazon.com/exec/obidos/tg/detail/-/B0000CFTAZ/103-1773255-9789422?v=glance)
